balls.text: reaches this one now, but can only heave the widish full one to mid off
misses this one, full and wide outside off, he was backing away towards leg, had to reach out but could not get to it
gets a full toss into the pads, but swings it straight to fine leg
gone this time, he tries to make room and drill the full delivery past extra cover but picks out the man, Raina takes it low, and safely
that has been smoked for a flat six over deep midwicket, off the front foot too, short on off, and he gets it off the middle, that made a loud crack
reaches out a full one widish outside off and gets something on it to send it towards point
another low full toss, this time angled in towards the pads, but he cannot connect
low full toss on middle drilled straight to long on
close to the blockhole, bunted down to long on
goes full and wide again, slower this time, and also too far wide
wide, full, there for the taking, and taken straight down the ground, there was too much width and Das gave it all he had
offspinner arrives from Bravo, dabbed towards point
tries to fetch it from well outside off and swing it behind square on leg, that seemed to come in a bit, he cannot connect as he gets into a tangle
another boundary, Das will go for them, lifts it straight over the bowler, that was certainly not off the middle of the bat, but it still sailed between long off and long on
they keep going for their shots, this one is off the middle, slaps a fullish one in the air over extra cover
pushed through extra cover for a single
punched to sweeper cover off the back foot

and another one, what is happening, the Kolkata Krumble, Tiwary looks to fetch a flighted delivery from just outside off and hit it over midwicket, it turns more than he had budgeted for, and Bravo has another straightforward take at long on
an inside edge now as he swings at a widish one outside off, away to short fine

YK has picked out long on with precision, tossed up around off, he goes for the big stroke, but gets it too high, and it sails tamely straight to Bravo on the long on rope, the horror season continues for YK, KKR slide further, what a turnaround
short of a length carrom ball, whipped from outside off to deep midwicket
nudged towards midwicket from middle
chips down the track, and works it in the air to deep midwicket
works a tossed up fullish one to deep midwicket
reaches out away from the body and turns it with the turn towards midwicket
blasted over wide long on, YK gets one away, there have not been too many of these from him this IPL, fetches it almost casually and deposits it some way into the crowd
gets forward and drives through extra cover
gets bat in front of pad and softly pushes it, cannot get it wide of the bowler
bashes a flat length ball on a couple of bounces to long on, he did not get hold of that one
drives a quicker and much fuller one to long off
length ball slapped away from the crease wide of sweeper cover
heaved from just outside off through midwicket
spins away way outside off, patted away to point
KKR slip further, Kallis, of all batsmen, goes for the reverse-sweep and gets it straight to slip, Kallis is not happy with the umpire's decision, replays show the ball came off the forearm
down the track again, no width this time, and he pushes it to long on
well done, down the track, and chips it with the spin over extra cover, beating long off and sweeper cover
full delivery worked through midwicket
opens the face and runs it through point
this time he times the drive but straight to extra cover
pushed on the leg side, bowler fields
sharp turn from a length on off, Kallis went for a drive but was beaten
reaches out and eases it in the air down to long off
driven down to long off for one
drives a tossed up ball to long off
big strike, Gautam is gone, he gave Jakati the charge, but got an inside edge on to pad, the ball then contrived to roll onto the stumps

breakthrough for CSK, Dhoni gets it with a direct hit, hit behind square leg, Baz wants the second, he was almost withing touching distance of Gautam before the KKR captain's hand comes up, too late for Baz, the throw is in to Dhoni, who hits the non-striker's stumps direct
hits a very full one down to long on
pushed wide of extra cover for a sharp run
down the pitch, Raina drags it full and wide, Baz slams it along the ground to long off
gets well forward and turns it through midwicket
misfield at extra cover by Faf gives them another single
poor line, down the leg side, and Baz goes down to swing it behind square leg, that has crashed into the rope
smacks an attempted cut into the ground through extra cover
drives a tossed up ball down the pitch
dabbed down behind point
rolls away off the pad down the pitch as he misses the work on the leg side
very neatly done, pitched up just outside off, and Gautam dabs it softly past the keeper to the third man rope
pushed down the ground to long off
pitches widish outside off and spins in sharply, cut away to sweeper cover
rocks back and punches through cover
goes back to a length ball and cuts it from just outside off to sweeper cover
shuffles across and works it to short fine
turns a tossed up full ball to vacant midwicket
tossed up very full, he stays in the crease and dabs it to short third man for his fifty
that has gone past short fine, Raina is after it, he pulls it back with a big slide but it rolls away into the rope
chips down the pitch and works it to deep midwicket
well played, down the pitch, opens the face as he drives it in the air wide of deep cover, a dive is not enough
that has been swung over midwicket, this time he connects with the slog sweep, wider outside off and he dispatches it
tries to slog sweep but cannot connect
down the track but pushes towards extra cover
pulled away to deep square leg
some turn and lots of bounce on middle, played out towards backward point
reverse-swept for a boundary wide of short third man
pushed to long off
played out to midwicket
driven to cover
played out to midwicket
punched back to him and Jakati drops it, went low to him but takeable
makes room as he looks to drive through extra cover, does not time the stroke
short, flat and he opens up to pull it wide of deep midwicket
down the track for a straight six
worked away to square leg
that's gone between keeper and slip, closer to slip than keeper, Raina did not react as Gautam steered this one
down the track and lofted over mid on
pushed away for a single to covers
short and pulled over deep square leg
pushed to cover for a single
chipped over mid on for two more
hit down the ground to the long on rope
loud appeal for lbw, a shade high, the ball rolls away towards third man
pushed down the ground for a couple
bounce this time for Hilfenhaus, pushed away towards cover
beaten outside off as he goes for a cut
pushed back down the track
gets it away first ball form Hilfenhaus, clipped away past midwicket
drives but straight to mid off
worked square on the leg side
defended down the pitch
pushed towards cover for a single
worked away backward of square leg

oh Bhatia, after all those legcutters, a low full toss results, and Bravo sends it just over the long on boundary with a powerful wallop, Chennai are alive in this IPL, they rush out to Bravo, Michael Hussey looks relieved, Gautam Gambhir stares hard in disbelief, Bhatia had nine to defend off the final over, he nearly did it
Rajat Bhatia has Eden Gardens screaming its guts out, legcutter on middle and leg, Bravo looks to cart it out of town, misses
cannot get it away for anything more than a single to deep square leg, Bhatia proving difficult to get away yet again
long on does well to get around to this straight hit, and keep them to two
with eight needed off five, Dhoni falls to Bhatia's legcutter, tries to heave it through midwicket, the length ball holds its line on middle and crashes into middle
slams a full delivery on the bounce to a scrambling long off
scoops a pitched up ball outside off wide of sweeper cover, timed well enough to require a dive from the fielder
seemed to be wanting to push it through the off side, but in the end the bat turned and he hit the full toss through midwicket
now a low full toss, he tries to arch back and dispatch it, to long on this time
Dhoni explodes, plants his legs firmly, wide apart, and hammers the pitched up ball way over long on with a mammoth swing
Dhoni doing it for CSK, drills a full delivery wristily over midwicket, power and timing combining there

and he has almost taken out de Lange first ball, de Lange would have taken it smack on the head, his hands came up late, by that time the ball had sped straight just over his head, brute force from Dhoni off that full ball outside off
legcutter worked from middle wide of deep square leg, the throw comes in to Bhatia but Dhoni charges in safely for the second
on the back foot deep in the crease but there is almost nothing to work with on the length ball and he has to push it to long on
eases a pitched up ball to long off
there is no pace off the pitch from Bhatia, and Bravo's punch goes straight to the bowler
length ball outside off slapped away to extra cover

Bhatia strikes, du Plessis goes for six over long on, picks up the slow length ball from middle and leg, and lofts it cleanly, but gets too much height on it, Tiwary takes it some way in from the long on rope
now the offbreak, he is outside the line of off as he turns it with the spin square on the leg side
one that turns away, defended solidly
eases a full ball through the non-striker's legs to long on
now this one spins in, it is tossed up outside off, Dhoni swings outside the line as it turns in and bounces
dabs one turning away from him but straight to point
shuffles across and works it away on the leg side
leaves the crease and eases it down to long off
skips down the track, works it away through midwicket
drives it hard to long off for one
the bat speed is going up from Dhoni, ball flies to point, could have been close but fielder could not collect the ball
tries the short ball but Dhoni hooks it away with very quick hands to the deep square leg rope
pitched up, swings it down the ground to long on
driven hard down the ground to long off, good comeback from Bhatia
under-edge now past the keeper as Dhoni wafts at a widish one outside off
now a leading edge, Dhoni is struggling to get them away, wanted to work it towards midwicket, the leading edge pops up towards Bhatia, but falls short
sees him making room and goes wide of off, batsman reaches out to slap it down to long off
Dhoni waits for pace on the ball, Bhatia takes it off completely, Dhoni tries to power it away, a single to sweeper cover is all he gets
hit down to long on
fourth dot on the trot, Eden Gardens likes it, punched to extra cover
another dot, the slow bouncer, Dhoni cannot connect with the pull
punched straight to extra cover now, Eden Gardens cheers for the dot ball
hits a widish delivery hard, but straight to shortish point, there are two men around point

shuffles across and works a back of a length ball behind square leg, they go for the second, could striker be struggling, yes, he is, the throw is right on target for Baz, who does not delay in taking off the bails, Raina is well short
flicked away in front of square leg
looks to steer it to third man but misses
does not quite get hold of the pull but manages to drag it to deep square
worked off the pad to square leg, who lets the throw rip even as the non-striker has safely made it, Sunil Gavaskar will not like that one bit
short, into the body, and he swivels to pull to fine leg
hit on the pad as he walks across too far outside off
drives it gracefully to sweeper cover
pulls a flat and shortish one angled in hard but to deep midwicket
now gets well forward and drives, to extra cover again
ending on middle and leg from a length, pushed towards extra cover
Raina breaks free with a slap over extra cover, long off gets to the ball with a dive, but it rolls past
punches it from the crease to extra cover
works it off the pad with the spin though square leg
corker of a turner from outside leg stump, leaves him clueless as it spits across his bat and ends well outside off, lots of bounce, for good measure
touch too short to the new batsman, he is able to punch it towards point off the back foot

that spun back in and took out off stump, Eden Gardens comes to life, extremely poor stroke in the end from Vijay, he was on the back foot, and was looking to cut the flighted length ball, but it spun back in and confounded him completely
pushes a tossed up ball to cover
a wicket, finally, top-edged sweep, loops in the air behind the keeper, short third runs towards it, but short fine leg gets there first and takes it
pushed away from the crease to cover
worked through  midwicket
dropped by Baz, it had been cut hard, and was a thick edge, tough chance
worked with the spin off the pad behind square leg
cuts a flat and wide one to sweeper cover
forget this night KKR, just not working at the moment, a pull that should have been stopped at deep midwicket goes through the fielder's hands
Hussey brings up fifty with a checked loft down to long off
could have been another opportunity if the throw had hit at the non-striker's from extra cover
He was not even in the frame, but the throw from extra cover misses the stumps, even if he had thrown it to the bowler, who had got back in time, the batsman would have been gone
make away in the stands, that has been carted rows and rows into the crowd over deep midwicket
they just keep coming, poor lines also continue from KKR, short of a length on leg stump, and swung over short fine leg
length ball on middle and off, pushed down to long off
nightmare over for Bhatia, now Hussey picks it from middle and launches it over deep square leg
now he sends it down the leg side, offcutter but starting well outside leg, and put away fine
moves away well outside off, there was width, it was dabbed to Gautam's left, but he was late in getting down and it speeds past by then
length ball, whipped away from middle and leg through midwicket
drives it away to sweeper cover for one
beaten this time as he tries to dab it to third man
that has raced away to the third man rope, throws his bat at a wide and full one, and it scoots away
mistimes a pull, he was looking to fetch it from outside off, but it was the slower one, top edge falls safely behind square
charges out, takes it on the full and belts it through cover
looks to bend his knee and squeeze out a full delivery from just outside off, but mistimes it towards extra cover, Tiwary runs in and lobs the ball towards the non-striker's stumps with a dive
worked wide of long on and they will charge back for the second
he tries to reverse sweep an offbreak from outside leg stump, it pops up in the air but falls well short of short third
spins across the left-hander, worked off the back foot to square leg
inside edge as he goes for a sweep, ball scurries past the keeper
tries to pull a short ball but it bounces too much
smashed over extra cover
stays in the crease and tries to cut a wide one going across, misses
neatly done, skips out, makes some room, and swings it cleanly over long on rope
waits on it and eases the widish delivery down to third man
flighted generously just outside leg, turning in and smothered off the front foot
a bit hesitant as he drives a tossed up full delivery to extra cover
sharp turn and bounce across the left-hander, pushed towards extra cover
loud appeal for lbw, that has pitched a mile outside leg as Hussey misses the sweep off a tossed up ball
offbreak spinning away, slapped towards extra cover
clatter! that is huge, short ball has been powered way over deep midwicket
drives in the air, Kallis at point dives to his left, but that has gone through his hands
goes for a cut to a wide delivery but misses
into the pads from back of a length, and Vijay has timed that off the pads, in the air but but through vacant backward square leg
widish length ball, he reaches out to drive but mistimes it totally
slower, and comes in a tad from outside leg stump, rolls away off the pad
that was some timing from Hussey, he charged out, and pulled the short delivery hard, the momentum was enough to take it over the deep midwicket rope
short of a length, cut away to point
lost it completely there, floated it up very full and very wide outside off
tries to repeat the shot, this one was slightly wider outside off, and he misses
that has been picked over midwicket, against the angle, got the timing just right on that one
more width, and this time is it put away with a punch past cover
width given, but it has been slapped straight to cover
defends a back of a length ball down the pitch
that did not go more than a few inches from the stumps as it was dropped softly, and they go through for a sharp single
beats the left-hander with another one going across him, Hussey poking at it from the crease
dabs a short of a length ball angled across him towards point
